statement: For every countable nonabelian simple group E such that, for every d!=1 and integer M>=1, there is b!=1 with conjugacy word length rho_b(d)>M, an explicit countable binary-tree system with identity exponent matrix has no solution in E. Lifting its coefficients through any epimorphism K->E from a subgroup K of a group H with specified classifying space B gives an actual aspherical inclusion B->Y, using countably many one- and two-cells, preserving integral homology and dimension at most max(dim B,2), embedding H and normally generated by H, and prohibiting maps pi1Y->E extending K->E. Interleaving these blocks with A28 yields a new actual two-dimensional acyclic resolution BG^alg->S2 of size at most continuum retaining A28 and A30. Every infinite simple quotient E of a nontrivial countable image then has finite but unbounded integer-valued conjugation-invariant norm N_E(g)=sup_{b!=1}rho_b(g), and every positive definite conjugation-invariant length on E is discrete. Every fixed conjugacy word norm rho_d on a surviving quotient is unbounded; hence all countable nonabelian simple targets of finite diameter in any one conjugacy word norm are excluded.

notes: No metric is assumed. Replacing L variable occurrences changes the root value by at most 2L conjugates of b or b^-1; the excluded element is ec^-1 in that order. A first-changing-edge path keeps two root values while excluding e. Finite prefixes eliminate internal generators root-first and leave the specified base wedged with frontier circles, so this block needs no torsion-free hypothesis or relative one-relator theorem. Failure of the displayed quantifier gives one d with uniform-in-b finite length; its finite normal-closure expressions bound all other elements pointwise. No implication that the resulting finite integer-valued norm is bounded is asserted. The new group G^alg is constructed afresh rather than silently strengthening the earlier examples. C independently audited the algebra and then the complete manuscript, including coefficient lifting, geometry, cardinality and all corollary assertions; all passed. Root independently read the full manuscript proof and confirmed it passes. The explicit comparison rho_d(g)<=N_E(g)<=N_E(d)rho_d(g) proves the finite-diameter exclusion; no extra hypothesis is left unchecked in this consequence.
